name: Ignis the World-Burner
title: Ancient Crimson Wyrm

attacks.name: Dragonfire Incineration
attacks.description: Breathes an unrelenting torrent of roaring dragonfire across images and content blocks, charring them black with flame shaders and turning them to ash particles.

attacks.name: Apex Jaw Devour
attacks.description: Swoops down and takes massive fiery bites out of images, leaving charred bite curves and swallowing the media whole into the dragon's fiery belly.

attacks.name: Talon Snatch & Catapult Throw
attacks.description: Snatches website headers, buttons or paragraphs in razor talons, flies them into high orbit, and hurls them down at hyper velocity causing crater shockwaves.

attacks.name: Wyrmling Brood Swarm
attacks.description: Summons a flock of ferocious baby fire drakes sweeping across the DOM in a flaming V-formation, torching every header and image in sight.

voicelines: ROOOAAAR! Ash and cinder to all CSS!
This webpage shall be my gold hoard's pyre!
Delicious images... crispy and well done!
